mutants.description: Mutant 1: omits unencumbered cash from equity in margin call calculation, causing artificial deficit.
Mutant 2: fails to divide margin deficit by haircut, under-liquidating assets and leaving deficit unresolved.
Mutant 3: omits permanent quadratic price impact in fire-sale discount estimation.
Mutant 4: suppresses endogenous haircut response during liquidity spiral, simulating loss spiral only.
Mutant 5: inverts policy backstop price floor logic, failing to halt spiral below floor.
